text.arabic_uthmani: قُل لِّعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ سِرًّۭا وَعَلَانِيَةًۭ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌۭ لَّا بَيْعٌۭ فِيهِ وَلَا خِلَٰلٌ

words.gloss_range: imperative directive speech that relays the following obligations to a defined believing audience
words.root_gloss_range: saying, declaring, transmitting, and directing; the local imperative selects performative command rather than reported speech
words.prose: {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) opens with a clipped imperative whose saying performs command: the Prophet is the recoverable relay, and the later jussives answer this speech act. The address is not generic, because the command is immediately routed to God's servants, and the ayah then moves from directive speech to obligation, deadline, and double negation.

topics.headline: performative command relay
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening word does not merely report speech; it makes prophetic saying the grammatical route by which believers are commanded to act.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a 2ms imperative, and the attachment evidence treats the later jussive clause as quoted content governed by the opening speech command.

words.gloss_range: address preposition that routes the commanded speech to the servant group, with benefactive pressure still coherent
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) turns the imperative into speech addressed to the servants rather than action performed on them. Its attached position before the servant noun makes the audience frame arrive before the duties, while the same particle can still feel beneficial: the message is both to them and for them.

topics.headline: addressee routing before content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle establishes recipients before any obligation is named, so the command is audience-specific from the start.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the servant phrase the prepositional complement of the speech command, and QAC marks the particle as governing the following genitive.

words.gloss_range: possessed servant group addressed as God's own, qualified by belief and oriented toward worshipful service
words.root_gloss_range: servitude, worship, devotion, and enslavement; the local possessive and believer qualifier select devoted relational service rather than degrading subjugation
words.prose: {{ar:عِبَادِيَ}} ({{tr:ʿibādiya}}) names the audience through possession: after the threat against wrongdoers (14:30), the scene turns to God's own servants before the obligations are stated. The plural construct gathers them as a class, the first-person suffix binds them to the speaker, and the following believer qualifier keeps the root field on devoted service and worship, not mere degradation.

topics.headline: possessed devoted servant audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the audience shift from threatened wrongdoers (14:30) to divinely possessed believing servants happens before prayer and spending become their duties.
topics.reason: The grammar supports the possessive genitive addressee; the broader root includes servitude and worship, but the believer qualifier narrows the local force toward devoted relation.

words.gloss_range: definite relative pronoun that narrows the possessed servants by the following belief clause
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) prevents the servant audience from staying broad or vague. It locks the next verb onto the possessed servants, so the addressees are simultaneously God's servants by relation and believers by qualification before the command content begins.

topics.headline: relative qualifier completes audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command waits until the audience has been doubly identified by possession and belief.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the relative pronoun as qualifying the servant noun and as subject of the following belief verb.

words.gloss_range: perfect plural belief/trust used as completed audience qualification without an explicit object
words.root_gloss_range: belief, trust, security, and entrusting; local Form IV selects committed belief/trust rather than a passive safety state
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) seals the addressees as those who have believed before the jussive duties begin. Its object is unstated, so the commitment is read inside the whole divine address frame, while the root's trust and security field prepares the later command to spend from entrusted provision.

topics.headline: completed belief before duty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief is not one more command in the list; it is the completed qualification that makes the addressees ready for prayer and spending.
topics.reason: QAC marks a Form IV perfect with no object specified; the broader root field is retained as trust/security pressure but narrowed to belief in the relative clause.

words.gloss_range: Form IV jussive causing prayer to stand as maintained practice, mediated through the opening command
words.root_gloss_range: standing, rising, establishing, maintaining, and resurrection; local Form IV selects causative establishment while the eschatological root pressure remains relevant
words.prose: {{ar:يُقِيمُوا۟}} ({{tr:yuqīmū}}) is the first jussive response to the opening command, with the same believing servants as its understood subject. Form IV makes the duty more than standing for prayer: it is causing the prayer to stand as a maintained practice, so after the prior path-loss frame (14:30) the verb functions as repair rather than mere posture.

topics.headline: jussive causative establishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first duty is a mediated command to make prayer stand firm as a repair after the prior path-loss frame (14:30), not a simple description of people praying.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a Form IV imperfect jussive with the prayer noun as object, and attachment evidence places it inside the quoted command content.

words.gloss_range: definite accusative prayer institution governed as the object to be established
words.root_gloss_range: prayer, supplication, blessing, following, connection, and debated nearness imagery; local governance selects the formal ritual-connection practice
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ}} ({{tr:al-ṣalāta}}) is definite and accusative, so the command presumes a known prayer practice and makes it the object to be established. Its verbal-noun shape lets prayer be treated as a maintainable institution, while connection and nearness remain supporting pressure under the ritual sense.

topics.headline: known prayer institution as object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that prayer is not introduced vaguely; it is a known institution made grammatically available to be established and maintained.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as definite accusative object; broader derivational pressures are retained only as coloring because the local verb-object frame selects formal prayer.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining spending to prayer as a second parallel obligation
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes the second jussive stand beside the first. The particle keeps prayer-establishment and spending joined without collapsing them into one act, giving the obligation panel a two-part shape.

topics.headline: connector for paired duties
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that spending is coordinated as a second obligation, not a subordinate explanation of prayer.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the spending clause with the prayer-establishment clause.

words.gloss_range: coordinated Form IV jussive commanding deliberate outward spending from prior provision
words.root_gloss_range: spending, passing out, tunnels, exhaustion, and hypocrisy; local Form IV and source phrase select intentional resource distribution
words.prose: {{ar:يُنفِقُوا۟}} ({{tr:yunfiqū}}) is the second jussive duty, assigned to the same believing servants and joined to prayer-establishment. The following source phrase makes the spending partitive: resources move outward from what God has provided, so the root's passage image is useful while the hypocrisy branch is only contrastive background.

topics.headline: deliberate outward redistribution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that spending is a deliberate outward channeling of prior provision, not a vague call to lose resources.
topics.reason: QAC marks a Form IV jussive and the attachment evidence links it to the source phrase; the broader root field is narrowed to spending as outward passage.

words.gloss_range: partitive source preposition inside the contracted source phrase for spending
words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) makes the spending source-marked and partial: the command is to spend from what was provided, not to define a total transfer. Because the spending verb comes first, the wording commands outward action before identifying the supplied source that enables it.

topics.headline: partitive source of spending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command first launches spending, then identifies a non-exhaustive portion drawn from divine provision as its source.
topics.reason: QAC marks the preposition as partitive/source, and the local syntax makes it govern the provided thing rather than the recipients.

words.gloss_range: completed divine provision to the servants, serving as the source from which spending is commanded
words.root_gloss_range: provision, allotment, sustenance, and broad divine grant; local object remains broad through the relative source phrase
words.prose: {{ar:رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:razaqnāhum}}) places divine provision before human redistribution. The verb carries both giver and recipients in its suffix chain, while the provided object remains broad through the preceding source phrase; the believers spend from an assigned grant, not from independent ownership.

topics.headline: prior provision grounds spending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that spending is framed as redistribution after divine provision, reversing any assumption that the resources originate autonomously with the givers.
topics.reason: QAC marks a perfect divine first-person plural verb with recipient suffix, and the local source phrase supplies the broad provided object.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative manner: spending secretly, as one pole of the giving-mode spectrum
words.root_gloss_range: secrecy, concealment, inwardness, delight, and related inner-place imagery; local sense selects concealed giving with innerness as coloring
words.prose: {{ar:سِرًّۭا}} ({{tr:sirran}}) is an accusative manner, so secrecy describes how spending happens rather than what is spent. Its indefinite form leaves the private mode open-ended, and its pairing with the public opposite makes the command cover the full range of giving modes.

topics.headline: secret mode within full spectrum
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that secret giving is grammatically a mode of spending and one pole of an exhaustive private-public pair.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence support an accusative adverbial manner; broader root imagery is narrowed to concealed giving with innerness as secondary pressure.

words.gloss_range: conjunction binding the public giving mode to the secret mode as a merism
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds the open mode to the secret one inside the same spending qualifier. The result is not a new command but a tight merism: hidden and public giving remain parallel extremes of one obligation.

topics.headline: connector for hidden-open merism
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that public giving is joined to secret giving as a coordinated mode, not as a separate clause.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence treats the second manner noun as coordinated with the first inside the spending clause.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative public-disclosure manner, paired with secret giving
words.root_gloss_range: openness, disclosure, making manifest, and publicness; local form selects deliberate open giving as a manner
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَانِيَةً}} ({{tr:ʿalāniyatan}}) shares the accusative manner role with the secret mode. It names deliberate public disclosure, not accidental visibility, and its form and cadence make open giving the matched opposite that completes the spending spectrum.

topics.headline: deliberate public giving mode
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that public giving is a legitimate intentional mode of the command, paired with secrecy rather than opposed to obedience.
topics.reason: QAC marks an accusative manner noun coordinated with the secret mode, and the lexical evidence supports disclosure/publicness as the selected sense.

words.gloss_range: temporal preposition opening the before-arrival deadline for the whole obligation panel
words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) pivots from what believers must do to the window in which it must be done. Here the particle is temporal, forming the before-phrase that scopes over prayer and spending together, not only the nearest giving phrase.

topics.headline: temporal pivot to deadline
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition opens a deadline for the whole duty panel, turning obligation into urgent pre-arrival action.
topics.reason: QAC marks the temporal usage, and the subordinate clause evidence shows the before-phrase governing the coming-day clause.

words.gloss_range: genitive temporal noun creating the before-arrival deadline phrase
words.root_gloss_range: before-ness, facing, direction, acceptance, and reception; local clause selects temporal priority while orientation remains background pressure
words.prose: {{ar:قَبْلِ}} ({{tr:qabli}}) is the genitive temporal noun that holds the coming-day clause as a deadline. The root's facing, reception, and direction field is not the selected sense here, but it gives the deadline an orientation: believers are positioned on the before side of an arrival beyond which the commanded actions cannot be substituted.

topics.headline: before-arrival deadline noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse builds a hard temporal window before the coming day, while the broader root field adds facing-orientation without replacing the time sense.
topics.reason: The following arrival clause selects temporal priority; acceptance and direction branches are retained only as secondary orientation pressure.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive particle converting the coming verb into a governed event-clause
words.prose: {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}) lets the arrival remain verbal while also making it governable after the before-noun. The deadline is therefore compact: not a long nominal phrase, but the coming of a day compressed into a live event-clause.

topics.headline: compressed governed event clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the coming day is held as both an event and a governed deadline object.
topics.reason: QAC marks subjunctive governance, and the local clause evidence places the particle inside the complement of the before-noun.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive Form I arrival verb that makes the day approach as the limit of action
words.root_gloss_range: coming, arriving, bringing, and giving in related forms; local Form I selects arrival rather than bestowal
words.prose: {{ar:يَأْتِيَ}} ({{tr:yaʾtiya}}) makes the day the thing that comes, with arrival foregrounded before the subject is named. The root can also move into giving in other forms, but this Form I verb selects approach: provision can be given and spent now, while this day arrives as the end of the exchange window.

topics.headline: arrival verb before named subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deadline is not static; the day is grammatically approaching the believers' present window of action.
topics.reason: QAC marks Form I subjunctive arrival governed by the particle; giving senses belong to other root forms and are only contrastive here.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative day that arrives and is characterized by the following double absence
words.root_gloss_range: day, appointed time, and event-period; local wording selects an eschatological event-time defined by what it lacks
words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمٌ}} ({{tr:yawmun}}) is nominative as the subject of arrival, yet it enters indefinitely, waiting for its identity to be supplied by the negations that follow. The day is therefore not a neutral date; it is an event-time characterized by no trade and no intimate recourse, echoing the no-trade formula while locally replacing intercession with friendship (2:254).

topics.headline: indefinite day defined by absence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the day is introduced without a title so its identity can be built by the two denied resources that follow.
topics.reason: QAC marks an indefinite nominative subject, and the following negated clauses in the attachment evidence characterize that day.

words.gloss_range: first negator over trade, opening a paired erasure frame
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) begins the day-description by negating trade inside that day. The standard nominative construction supports existential negation, while the accepted accusative variant makes genus-negation explicit; together they press the reader toward total commercial unavailability, then prepare the second negation.

topics.headline: first negation of recourse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first negation removes a whole category of exchange, not merely one failed transaction.
topics.reason: QAC notes the standard negation and variant genus-negation; both remain compatible with the local paired-negation structure.

words.gloss_range: indefinite verbal noun for reciprocal exchange, negated as an unavailable recourse on the day
words.root_gloss_range: selling, buying, exchange, contract, and pledge; local negation covers reciprocal transaction as a category
words.prose: {{ar:بَيْعٌ}} ({{tr:bayʿun}}) is an indefinite verbal noun under negation, so the ayah denies the institution of exchange rather than narrating one failed sale. Because the root field covers selling, buying, and contractual exchange, the negation removes both sides of value-transfer logic; the no-trade formula is echoed but paired here with friendship rather than intercession (2:254).

topics.headline: exchange system denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied resource is the entire reciprocal exchange system, including buying, selling, and negotiated transfer.
topics.reason: The form is a gerund/indefinite noun under negation; lexical evidence supports reciprocal exchange while the local formula comparison is explicitly supplied by CRITICAL rows.

words.gloss_range: locative-temporal phrase whose pronoun refers back to the day and makes it the container of absence
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهِ}} ({{tr:fīhi}}) keeps the day active without repeating it. The suffix refers back to the day, not to trade, so the absence is located inside that event-time; its position after the first negated noun sets the domain before the second absence extends it.

topics.headline: day as container of absence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that trade is absent within the coming day itself, and the same located domain is ready to receive the second negation.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a preposition with pronoun referring to the day, and the local negated clause makes that day the temporal-locative domain.

words.gloss_range: conjunction joining the second negation to the first as cumulative erasure
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins the second denial to the first, making commerce and intimate relation cumulative losses rather than alternatives. Bound to the renewed negator, it keeps the final phrase inside the same day-characterization.

topics.headline: connector for cumulative absences
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second absence extends the first within one closing scene, escalating from impersonal exchange to intimate relation.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence coordinates the second negated clause with the first and keeps it in the same day-description.

words.gloss_range: second negator giving independent force to the denial of intimate social recourse
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) repeats the negation before the friendship noun, giving the second absence its own force rather than leaving it as a faint appendage to trade. The accepted case-shift variant also reaches this second noun, so the two-beat closure presses toward categorical denial of both resources.

topics.headline: second negation with independent force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that friendship is not merely included under the first negation; it is separately and rhythmically denied.
topics.reason: QAC and CRITICAL rows support the repeated negative particle, and the coordinated clause gives the second denial its own governed noun.

words.gloss_range: abstract intimate friendship/access noun negated as the final unavailable human recourse
words.root_gloss_range: intimate friendship, through-access, penetration, gaps, and defect; local noun selects relational access while root imagery intensifies the denial
words.prose: {{ar:خِلَٰلٌ}} ({{tr:khilālun}}) closes the ayah with the more intimate denied resource. It is an abstract friendship/access noun, not a personal friend-form, so the negation removes the relation category itself; the root's through-access imagery fits the day-as-container, and the echo of the intimate-friend field associated with Ibrahim (4:125) makes the ending contrastive in Sūrat Ibrāhīm.

topics.headline: final denial of intimate access
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends by stripping away relational access itself, deeper than commercial exchange and marked by a rare abstract friendship noun.
topics.reason: The local noun is indefinite under negation and QAC treats it as the second negated subject; broader piercing and gap imagery is retained as root pressure but narrowed to the abstract friendship/access noun.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opening speech command addresses those marked both as God's servants and as believers.
baseline_models.mechanism: An uttered directive is relayed to people whose trusting assent and submissive service are meant to become conduct; speech is therefore incomplete until the addressees enact it.

activation_trace.role: Audible production of speech supplies the initiating relay whose success must appear beyond speech.
Submissive worship and obedience make the addressees responsive servants rather than a merely named audience.
Heart-settling assent supplies the inward trust that the following practices externalize.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports two duties to an already believing audience.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a relay in which spoken command and inward assent are completed only by practiced service.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired clauses require establishing prayer and spending from what was provided.
baseline_models.mechanism: One practice maintains a standing order while the other sends received stock out of possession. Their pairing joins durable worship to material release, and the provision clause denies that the released material originated with its present holder.

activation_trace.role: Care, preservation, and oversight make establishment a sustained maintenance function rather than a single performance.
The departure of wealth as expenditure supplies the outward release paired with maintained prayer.
An apportioned gift marks the spendable stock as received allocation rather than self-originated property.

changed_reading.before: Prayer and almsgiving are adjacent obligations.
changed_reading.after: The pair forms one economy of faithful life: preserve the worship-order and release part of the allocation sustaining it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Expenditure is explicitly distributed across concealed and manifest modes.
baseline_models.mechanism: The passage image within expenditure, together with the hidden/open pair, presents giving as a flow that must find outlets across both visibility conditions. Visibility qualifies the route of release, not whether release occurs.

activation_trace.role: A through-passage with an outlet supplies the spatial model of provision moving beyond the holder.
A route with one opening displayed and another concealed makes differential visibility internal to the expenditure channel.
Concealment in an interior supplies the hidden route of the paired distribution.
Manifest appearance and public disclosure supply the visible route of the paired distribution.

changed_reading.before: The verse permits either private or public charity.
changed_reading.after: The verse demands provision find an outlet across the full visibility field, with concealment and publicity functioning as distinct channels.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Action is required before an approaching day characterized by neither sale nor intimate alliance.
baseline_models.mechanism: The approaching event closes two ordinary means of shifting a deficit: priced exchange and protective relationship. Present action is urgent because neither assets nor social intimacy will later let one transfer or outsource the needed response.

activation_trace.role: Temporal precedence supplies the still-open interval in front of the event.
Arrival makes the deadline an event advancing toward the addressees rather than an abstract date.
A day as a severe happening gives the arriving boundary its crisis character.
Price-mediated exchange supplies the financial transfer mechanism explicitly removed.
Intimacy penetrating the self supplies the relational support mechanism explicitly removed.

changed_reading.before: The verse warns that Judgment will have no commerce or friendship.
changed_reading.after: The verse closes both fungible wealth and protective social capital, making the present response personal and nondelegable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier gratitude cues recast expenditure as the visible efficacy of a received gift: gratitude makes even little provision show an effect and is followed by increase, while divine self-sufficiency rules out payment to a needy giver.

activation_trace.role: Sufficiency with little and the appearance of its effect make gratitude a model for letting provision become effective beyond possession.
Growth and increase supply the promised continuation following grateful response.
Complete independence removes any model in which human spending enriches or supplies God.
The allotted gift is the received material whose effect can be made visible through grateful expenditure.
Material departure supplies the enacted form through which gratitude becomes socially effective.

structural_cues: 14:5 joins remembrance of God's days to patience and gratitude; 14:7 places increase after gratitude; 14:8 immediately denies divine need.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gratitude, increase, self-sufficiency, and later received provision; I infer that spending is one way gratitude makes the gift's effect appear. A live alternative is that gratitude here names a wider obedient posture rather than expenditure specifically.

changed_reading.before: Spending is a required subtraction from one's provision.
changed_reading.after: Spending is provision becoming visibly effective as gratitude, without functioning as tribute that supplies God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Divine favor is imaged as release without compensation, and believers are told to rely upon God. Together these cues activate an unpriced relay: received favor can be sent onward because reliance, rather than retained stock, bears security.

activation_trace.role: Release without compensation supplies a noncommercial image for divine favor received by servants.
Reliant dependence supplies the security condition that permits provision to leave one's control.
The apportioned gift identifies what is received before it is relayed.
Expenditure is the onward material release in the inferred relay.
The later absence of priced exchange sharpens the contrast between gratuitous receipt and attempted purchase.

structural_cues: 14:11 places divine favor among servants beside the believers' reliance on God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies favor without compensation and reliance; I supply the arrow from receiving such favor to relaying material provision. The live alternative is that 14:11's favor concerns messenger-selection only and activates the spending model by analogy.

changed_reading.before: One spends because one has been commanded to part with owned goods.
changed_reading.after: One relays an unpriced grant, with reliance on the giver displacing security based on retained goods.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ash simile makes earned output lose substance and control under a scattering wind. This revises the no-sale deadline from mere market closure to loss of usable liquidity and agency: provision must be directed while it can still be directed.

activation_trace.role: Acquiring sought benefit supplies the stock whose later usability is tested.
Combustion residue supplies the image of accumulated output reduced to almost weightless remains.
A wind that lifts and scatters things supplies the force making the residue unrecoverable.
Effective capacity and control are explicitly negated, turning the image into an agency failure.
Present expenditure supplies a directed departure before later scattering makes direction impossible.
The removed sale channel names the later inability to turn holdings into a useful countervalue.

structural_cues: 14:18 says the disbelievers can exercise no capacity over anything they acquired after their works become wind-driven ash.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet directly applies ash to works and acquisitions; I extend its loss-of-control mechanism to the focus verse's spendable holdings. A live alternative keeps the simile strictly about invalid works rather than material assets.

changed_reading.before: The deadline means wealth cannot buy help later.
changed_reading.after: The deadline also means acquired stock can lose all controllable form, so it must be purposefully released while agency remains.

context_deltas.mechanism: Followers ask powerful leaders to make them sufficient against punishment, and the prior inviter later denies reciprocal rescue. These failed vertical and reciprocal ties specify what the absence of intimate alliance does: no network can absorb liability or furnish an indemnifying response.

activation_trace.role: A liability that clings to following turns social allegiance into the burden the followers hope leaders will absorb.
Sufficiency and availing supply the protective service requested from the failed leaders.
Reciprocal rescue and answering distress are denied in both directions, closing peer-to-peer bailout.
Deep friendship supplies the focus verse's relational channel, now specified as unable to transfer rescue.
A need that would fill a gap supplies the deficit that failed leaders and companions cannot meet.

structural_cues: 14:21 dramatizes followers appealing to leaders; 14:22 has the inviter disclaim authority and mutual rescue after the matter is settled.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed sufficiency and rescue across social ties; I infer that these scenes operationalize the focus verse's absent intimate alliance. The alternative is that the focus term refers only to intercession by close friends, not social capital broadly.

changed_reading.before: No friend will be present or useful on that day.
changed_reading.after: Neither hierarchy nor reciprocity can transfer liability, make a person sufficient, or answer distress; present obedience cannot be outsourced to a network.

context_deltas.mechanism: The good-word tree turns speech into a stable organism with recurring yield. It activates a functional mapping in the focus verse: the command becomes rooted through maintained prayer and bears recurrent material fruit through expenditure.

activation_trace.role: Meaningful speech connecting speakers supplies the verbal seed whose consequences can become embodied.
Durable stability supplies the rooted persistence mapped to maintaining prayer.
A high branch emerging from its base supplies outward extension from an inwardly fixed origin.
The yield of tree and crop supplies the useful output mapped to released provision.
Each fitting interval supplies recurrence rather than a one-time fruiting.
The spoken directive is the focus verse's verbal beginning.
Sustained care makes prayer the inferred stabilizing and cultivating function.
Material outflow becomes the inferred recurring fruit by which rooted speech benefits others.

structural_cues: 14:24-25 moves from a good word to fixed root, elevated branch, and recurrent yield; 14:27 again joins believers to the stable saying.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the word-tree mechanism; I map prayer to root-maintenance and spending to fruit. The live alternative is that the tree concerns stable belief and speech generally, without assigning its plant parts to the two focus practices.

changed_reading.before: The opening command simply transmits two regulations.
changed_reading.after: The command seeks to become a rooted, recurrently productive form of life: prayer stabilizes it and expenditure is its outward yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding command to enjoy temporarily toward a fiery destination is answered by the focus command to establish and spend. Together with the earlier replacement of blessing by denial, the adjacency creates a fork in how present goods are transformed before their destination becomes fixed.

activation_trace.role: One thing standing in place of another supplies the disastrous present transformation of blessing into denial.
Beneficent good condition identifies the material or favor being misconverted.
A second audible command creates the explicit structural parallel with the focus verse's opening command.
Enjoyed utility supplies the self-contained use of present goods on the first branch of the fork.
Movement toward an eventual outcome links temporary enjoyment to its declared destination.
The repeated command marker opens the constructive branch: maintain prayer and release provision.
The later closure of exchange limits the interval in which present goods can still be reoriented.

structural_cues: 14:30 and 14:31 are adjacent commands with different addressees, uses of present goods, and stated destinations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies replacement of blessing, temporary enjoyment, destination, and the adjacent commands; I infer a fork of material orientation. The alternative reads the first command as pure threat without making it a foil for the believers' expenditure.

changed_reading.before: The focus verse adds ordinary devotional duties after a warning to opponents.
changed_reading.after: It gives the constructive counter-command for present goods: convert received benefit into maintained worship and social release rather than terminal enjoyment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated flow images form a hydraulic economy: enduring gift runs, water descends, fruit emerges as provision, and rivers continue their course. The focus expenditure passage becomes the next outlet in that current, so giving continues rather than merely diminishes provision.

activation_trace.role: Continuous provision and giving supply the durable flow image first attached to the garden rivers.
Downward arrival supplies the current's incoming movement from sky to earth.
Water delivered through pouring and irrigation supplies the material carrier of the incoming gift.
Passage outward supplies the transition by which hidden growth emerges as fruit.
Rain descending as provision fuses the water sequence with the focus verse's named received stock.
Unimpeded coursing supplies the onward movement of the ship through the created system.
A channel cut through earth by running water supplies the large-scale outlet completing the context mechanism.
A passage possessing an exit lets human expenditure function as the inferred social outlet of the same current.

structural_cues: 14:32 immediately follows the focus verse and traces water from descent through fruit-as-provision to ships and rivers in motion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence of descent, emergence, provision, and flow; I supply the hydraulic analogy linking that sequence to expenditure. The live alternative is that 14:32 only grounds divine beneficence and does not imply an onward human circulation rule.

changed_reading.before: Spending removes a portion from a finite allotment.
changed_reading.after: Spending gives received provision its next outlet within a larger created current of descent, emergence, and continued flow.

context_deltas.mechanism: The barren-valley prayer links settlement for prayer, human hearts inclining toward the family, fruit provision, and gratitude. The focus pair can therefore be read as a settlement ecology: prayer gives the community its orienting purpose, provision arrives through created and social channels, and expenditure completes gratitude by recirculating it.

activation_trace.role: A valley as a floodcourse supplies a receptive place that depends on inflow rather than autonomous abundance.
Cultivation and plant growth, explicitly absent in the verse, mark the settlement's lack of local food production.
Maintaining and guarding the practice makes prayer the stated organizing purpose of settlement.
The inclination of desire supplies a human current drawing other people's hearts toward the settled family.
An apportioned grant supplies what the locally barren settlement must receive.
Fruit as realized benefit supplies the concrete provision entering the settlement.
Recognition of gift and praise of the giver name the intended response to the incoming fruit.
The release of wealth supplies the inferred onward social leg that completes the received provision's circulation.

structural_cues: 14:37 repeats the focus construction of establishing prayer and provision, but embeds it in a barren settlement, inclined hearts, fruits, and gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies every link except the final claim that spending completes the settlement's circulation; that arrow is mine. A live alternative is that the hearts and fruits are independent divine answers and not human channels of provision.

changed_reading.before: Prayer and spending are individual devotions performed from one's private allotment.
changed_reading.after: They sustain a community whose worship, attraction, incoming provision, gratitude, and outgoing support form one interdependent ecology.

context_deltas.mechanism: The recurrence of concealment and declaration under comprehensive divine knowledge relocates the secret/public distinction to the human social field. Concealment does not make expenditure evidentially absent to God, and publicity does not inform God.

activation_trace.role: Complete disclosure to a knower supplies the invariant awareness spanning both visibility modes.
Concealment and hiddenness are both named and then denied any capacity to escape divine awareness.
Manifest declaration repeats the focus verse's public pole inside the knowledge contrast.
Interior concealment supplies the private expenditure mode whose divine visibility remains unchanged.

structural_cues: 14:38 repeats the focus verse's hidden/manifest opposition and immediately says nothing is hidden from God in earth or sky.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet directly supplies invariant divine knowledge; I infer that the two spending modes concern human reach, exposure, and intention rather than divine detection. The alternative is that the pair simply emphasizes comprehensiveness without differentiating audiences.

changed_reading.before: Secret and public identify whether the gift is seen.
changed_reading.after: They identify human visibility channels only; both are fully present to divine knowledge, so publicity cannot add evidence and secrecy cannot erase it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Abraham asks to be a maintainer of prayer, then asks forgiveness for the day the account stands. The repeated standing root creates a temporal handoff: prayer is voluntarily kept upright now before accounting rises as an unavoidable event.

activation_trace.role: Care and sustained oversight make Abraham's requested relation to prayer an enduring present vocation.
The specified ritual practice identifies what is to be kept established.
The severe event-day supplies the future boundary toward which the prayer request looks.
Resurrection and the rising of the Hour supply the unavoidable future standing of the account.
Numbering and reckoning specify what rises on that day.
The focus imperative places present voluntary maintenance on the near side of that future standing.

structural_cues: 14:40-41 places the request to maintain prayer directly before the day on which the account stands.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated standing root and sequence; I infer a deliberate contrast between voluntary establishment and unavoidable accounting. A live alternative treats the recurrence as ordinary phrasing without a functional handoff.

changed_reading.before: Prayer should be established before Judgment arrives.
changed_reading.after: The verse contrasts two standings: keep prayer upright voluntarily now before the account itself inevitably rises.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later warning repeats the day-coming construction and then records a plea for delay specifically to answer the call and follow the messengers. This identifies 'before' as the sole response window; after arrival, even declared willingness cannot reopen enacted obedience.

activation_trace.role: The severe event-day repeats the exact kind of approaching boundary named in the focus verse.
Arrival repeats the focus motion and shows the threatened boundary in its realized state.
Requested postponement names the temporal reversal sought only after the response window has closed.
A fixed terminal interval supplies the bounded extension the speakers request.
Nearness in time and impending completion make even the requested reprieve minimal.
Answering speech supplies the belated verbal response the condemned promise to convert into action.
Following in another's track supplies the belated conduct promised after answering the call.
Precedence names the still-open side of the boundary on which the focus addressees can act.

structural_cues: 14:44 repeats 'a day comes' and places a request for delay, answering the call, and following messengers only after punishment arrives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies the repeated arrival and belated response; I infer that this scene explains the focus verse's urgency. The alternative is that the promised answer and following encompass obedience generally rather than the two focus practices.

changed_reading.before: The word 'before' supplies a general warning not to procrastinate.
changed_reading.after: It marks the only interval in which hearing can become effective conduct; post-arrival intention and speech cannot recover the missed response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah creates asymmetric accounting: divine benefits cannot be enumerated, yet every self is swiftly repaid for what it acquired. The focus verse lies between uncountable receipt and exact nontransferable settlement; sale and friendship cannot net one person's account against another's.

activation_trace.role: Enumerating discrete items supplies the attempted accounting operation that fails for divine benefits.
Beneficent good condition supplies the incoming side whose abundance exceeds enumeration.
Exhaustive numerical reckoning supplies the stronger counting operation explicitly declared impossible for blessings.
A deed met by its corresponding recompense supplies the exact outgoing settlement.
Each self's acquired benefit or result identifies the individually attributable account base.
Rapid numbering and account close the sequence with precise reckoning.
Received allocation places the focus addressees on the uncountably benefited side of the asymmetry.
The removed exchange mechanism prevents purchased offset or transfer at final settlement.
The removed intimate tie prevents relational offset or transfer at final settlement.

structural_cues: 14:34 denies exhaustive counting of divine benefits; 14:51 assigns recompense to every self for its own acquisition and calls the account swift.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both accounting poles; I infer a deliberately asymmetric ledger and read no sale or alliance as barring offsets. A live alternative keeps blessing-counting and final account as separate rhetorical claims without a shared ledger mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Spend some provision now because commerce and friendship will be absent later.
changed_reading.after: Respond to an incoming gift beyond enumeration before an exact personal account in which neither price nor relationship can transfer or net away one's acquisition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses the prayer and fire domains and the QAC surface roots differ, but the packet explicitly cross-maps both occurrences into inventories carrying both senses and places them two ayat apart. It remains anchored in the focus prayer term and the adjacent fire encounter; downstream prose should call it a root-family echo or contrast, not claim that ritual prayer lexically means burning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The command to establish prayer follows immediately after a description of entering fire and a destination toward fire.

activation_trace.role: Encountering fire and its heat supplies the involuntary contact immediately before the focus command.
The alternate mapped inventory independently preserves the same fire-contact image, strengthening the local root-family echo.
Specified ritual worship supplies the voluntary practice commanded on the near side of the deadline.
The alternate mapped inventory preserves prayer as an abiding obligation, completing the packet-authorized cross-domain pairing.

changed_reading.before: Establishing prayer and the preceding fire warning are neighboring but unrelated instructions and threats.
changed_reading.after: The root-family echo tentatively contrasts a voluntarily maintained orientation in prayer now with an involuntary encounter with fire at the declared destination.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the absence of friendship through a later physical binding scene rather than through an explicit synonym. It remains valid as a structural contrast anchored in the focus negation and the later pairing-and-fetter branches; downstream prose should present it as an ironic spatial reversal, not as the dictionary meaning of the focus term.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verse removes intimate relational support on the coming day, while a later scene shows people forcibly joined together.

activation_trace.role: Friendship penetrating the self supplies the voluntary, potentially supportive togetherness that is absent.
Joining and binding one thing to another supplies togetherness stripped of voluntary intimacy.
A companion coupled to a companion gives the forced binding an ironic social silhouette.
Tight restraint in fetters makes the later proximity coercive and incapable of mutual aid.

changed_reading.before: No friendship means isolated persons lack friendly assistance.
changed_reading.after: The day may contain extreme proximity without relationship: bodies can be bound together while every supportive bond has become functionless.

strongest_changes: The deadline closes both financial exchange and relational indemnity, making response nontransferable.
The exact hidden/manifest recurrence in 14:38 makes spending visibility a human-channel distinction under invariant divine knowledge.
The barren-valley prayer in 14:37 expands prayer, provision, inclined hearts, gratitude, and expenditure into a settlement ecology.
The repeated day-coming scene in 14:44 defines 'before' as an irrecoverable response window.
Uncountable received benefit in 14:34 and exact personal reckoning in 14:51 create an asymmetric account around the focus verse.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context turned a compact devotional command into interacting material, temporal, social, and ecological mechanisms. Especially diagnostic were the adjacent command fork at 14:30-31, the water-to-provision flow after the focus, the Abrahamic repetition of prayer and provision, and the later closure of delayed response and transferable rescue.
remaining_uncertainties: The hydraulic reading depends on a reader-supplied analogy between created watercourses and human expenditure.
The word-tree mapping of prayer to stability and spending to fruit is coherent but not explicitly assigned by the packet.
The prayer/fire echo is packet-authorized across mapped inventories but should remain an exploratory root-family contrast.
The asymmetric-ledger model may join two accounting passages that can also be read independently.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Worship and expenditure establish circulation before exchange closes.** `ق و م` `B003` (rising to undertake) and `B009` (mainstay), `ص ل و` `B003` (prescribed worship), `ن ف ق` `B002` (wealth going out), and `ر ز ق` `B001` (allotted gift) link vertical establishment with outward flow. The following rain-fruit-river system supplies a circulation model. I infer received provision must be kept moving to remain socially life-giving. The commands read as maintaining a communal economy before the terminal day.

2. **Hidden and manifest giving close the gaps that sale and friendship cannot later fill.** `س ر ر` `B001` (hidden inwardly), `ع ل ن` `B001` (made open), `ب ي ع` `B001` (priced exchange), and `خ ل ل` `B002` (need as gap) plus `B003` (intimate friendship) preserve two readings of *khilal*. I infer comprehensive visibility conditions train integrity now, while the later day removes both transactional purchase and relational intercession. The final pair remains economically and socially double.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayat 14:32–34 made expenditure look like participation in a much larger flow of received provision; humans maintain circulation but do not originate its inputs.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Establishing prayer is active maintenance of an upright practice.** `ق و م B003` supplies resolving and rising to undertake a matter, `ق و م B004` care and preservation, and `ص ل و B003` prescribed worship. The command follows 14:27's divine stabilization and precedes 14:33's continuously persistent celestial service. The packet supplies firmness, human establishment, and cosmic persistence; I infer that prayer must be repeatedly maintained. `يُقِيمُوا ٱلصَّلَوٰة` reads as sustaining an upright institution, not performing an isolated act.
2. **Expenditure returns provision to circulation.** `ن ف ق B002` supplies wealth going out as expenditure, while `ر ز ق B001` supplies provision as an allotted gift. The syntax makes what goes out a subset of what was first provided; 14:32-34 then display water, fruit, transport, cycles, and gifts as an incoming support network. The packet supplies inflow and outflow; I infer that spending keeps provision circulating through human hands. `يُنفِقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ` therefore reads as a return-flow, not independent generosity.
3. **Hidden and manifest giving cover the full visibility range.** `س ر ر B001` supplies inward concealment and `ع ل ن B001` manifestation. The coordinated pair refuses to make either visibility condition exclusive, and 14:33's governed night/day repeats the same alternation inside this focus window. I infer that both channels belong to one ordered practice. `سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَة` reads as continuity across visibility modes rather than two audiences.
4. **The coming day disables market and friendship as substitute mechanisms.** `ب ي ع B001` supplies price exchange, and `خ ل ل B003` intimate friendship. Their joint negation follows worship and giving, which cannot be purchased or outsourced at the endpoint. The packet supplies the commands and the later closure; I infer that present noncommercial acts prepare for a state where transactional and relational substitution no longer operate. The urgency is structural, not merely chronological.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 14:32-34 supplied the incoming provision network that makes expenditure a return-flow, while 14:33's night/day alternation sharpened secret/public giving as one practice across visibility modes.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.
Azlık, kişinin yoksullaşması veya toplum içinde düşük ve değersiz görülmesi sonucuna uzanabilir.
Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin en üstünü veya başını çekirdek anlam olarak verir; dağın yuvarlak üst bölümü, insan başı ve kılıcın başındaki topuz bu çekirdeğin açık uzmanlaşmalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol uzamsal başı ve en üst parçayı bildirir; sayısal azlık ya da büyük kap anlamını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel baş ve en üst bölüm anlamı ile dağ tepesi, insan başı ve kılıç topuzu gibi yapıya bağlı uzmanlaşmalar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başını veya en üst bölümünü bildirir. Dağın üstteki yuvarlak parçası, insan başı ve kılıcın sap ucundaki topuz bu uzamsal çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin veya oluşumun başı ya da en üstte bulunan bölümüdür.
Dağın en üstünde yer alan, kimi tanımda yuvarlak biçimli bölümünü adlandırır.
İnsan başı ile kılıcın sap ucundaki başlık veya topuz da aynı üst ve baş kavramıyla adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir şeyin başı ve en üst bölümü üzerinde birleşir; dağ tepesi temel örnektir, insan başı ile kılıç topuzu da aynı biçimsel ve uzamsal çizgide yer alır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyük bir küp veya iri kap anlamında birleşir; iki kaplık ölçü ve belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler de aynı kap anlamını somutlaştırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol büyük bir kap türünü ve onun ölçü değerini kapsar; nicelik azlığı veya dağ tepesi anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Büyük küp anlamı çekirdektir; belirli bir bölgeye bağlanan kap adı ile iki kaplık ölçü yalnızca kendi yapılardaki uzmanlaşmalardır.

concept_map.definition: Büyük bir küpü veya küpe benzeyen iri kabı bildirir. Belirli bir bölgenin iri küpleri ve iki böyle kabın aldığı miktar bu kap anlamına bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar iri bir küp veya büyük kap üzerinde birleşir; tanınmış bölgesel kaplar büyüklüğü örnekler, iki kaplık kullanım ise nesne adını kapasite ölçüsüne taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi hareket ettirip sallandırma, nesnenin bulunduğu yerde kararlı duramaması ve hareketin çıkardığı sesi birlikte verir; bunlar tek bir fiziksel hareket olayının neden, sonuç ve işitsel yönleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol genel fiziksel oynama, kararsızlık ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir; korku veya öfkeden doğan insana özgü titreme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak kolun hareket ettirme, sallanma, yerinde duramama ve hareket sesi anlamlarını kapsar; özel bir yapının anlamı genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi hareket ettirerek yerinden oynatmayı ve onun kararsızca sallanıp bulunduğu yerde duramamasını bildirir; bu hareketin çıkardığı ses de aynı olayın işitsel yönüdür.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun yerinden oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olmaktır.
Nesnenin bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmayıp sallanması, oynaması veya düzensiz hareket etmesidir.
Sallanma ve yer değiştirme sırasında çıkan ses, hareket olayının işitsel belirtisi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar dışarıdan hareket ettirme ile nesnenin kararsızca sallanıp yerinde duramaması üzerinde birleşir; hareketin sesi bu fiziksel olayın ayrılmaz işitsel belirtisi olarak eklenir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Neden olunan hareketi ve nesnenin ortaya çıkan kararsız sallanmasını birlikte kapsayan temel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Hareket ettirme nedenini ve sabit kalamayan nesnenin sallanma sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin bir nesneyi hareket ettirerek onun oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dışarıdan uygulanan hareketi ve nesnenin sarsılması sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin gevşeklik veya kararsızlık nedeniyle bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmadığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sabit kalamama ile düzensiz sallanma durumunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sallanan veya oynayan nesnenin çıkardığı sesin adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sesin genel bir ses değil, hareketten doğan işitsel belirti oluşunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: sallanma, yerinde duramama ve hareket sesi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol nesnenin yerinde duramamasını ve hareket sırasında çıkan sesi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol kalp, deniz, diş, ağaç ve gök gürültüsü gibi alanlardaki şiddetli sarsıntıyı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun sallanmasına veya sarsılmasına neden olmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Fiziksel sarsılma alanı yakındır; bu kol hareket ettirme, sabit kalamama ve hareket sesini kurarken komşu kol farklı varlıklardaki şiddetli sarsıntıyı öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kolda ses, nesnenin kararsız hareketi ve sallanmasının sonucu olarak ortaya çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol çan, gök gürültüsü ve bulut gibi kaynaklardan gelen çınlama ve gürleme seslerini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da bir nesnenin hareketi sırasında ortaya çıkan işitilebilir sesi içerebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolun çekirdeği fiziksel kararsızlık ve sallanmadır, ses ikincildir; komşu kolda ses ve çınlama daha bağımsız bir anlam alanı oluşturur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol nesnenin oynatılması, yerinde duramaması ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol insanda korku veya öfke yüzünden ortaya çıkan titremeyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da gözle görülen düzensiz bir sarsılma veya titreme görünümü taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolda nesne ve fiziksel kararsızlık kurucudur; komşu kolda insan bedeni ile korku veya öfke nedeni kurucudur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel sallama, hareketten doğan ses ve aynı kökteki duygusal titreme karşılaştırmaları fiziksel hareket çekirdeğinin sınırını en açık biçimde gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, özgür kişinin karşıtı olan ve hukuken sahip olunup alınıp satılabilen insanı açıkça tanımlar. Bu nedenle dalın çekirdeği tapınma ya da boyun eğme eylemi değil, kölelik durumundaki kişidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam, köle edinme eylemini ve dinsel bağlılığı değil, özgür olmayan kişinin statüsünü bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın bir ad anlamıdır; tanım herhangi bir özel söz öbeğine bağlı ek anlam taşımaz.

concept_map.definition: Özgür olmayan, bir başkasının mülkiyetinde sayılan ve eski hukuk düzeninde alınıp satılabilen insandır.

facets.statement: Kişi özgürün karşıtı olarak bir başkasının mülkiyetinde bulunur.
Hukuki ölçüt, kişinin alım satıma konu edilebilmesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bu kişiyi özgürün karşıtı ve sahip olunan insan olarak ortak biçimde tanımlar; hukuki açıklama alınıp satılabilmeyi belirleyici sayar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kölelik statüsündeki kişiyi hem toplumsal hem de eski hukuki sınırıyla karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Özgür olmama, başkasına ait sayılma ve kişi olma özelliklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlam tarihsel mülkiyet statüsünü zaten açıkça gösterdiğinde doğal ve kısa karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Özgürün karşıtı olan ve bir başkasına ait sayılan kişiyi belirtir.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: köle doğmuş veya kuşaklar boyunca köle kalmış kişiler

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal doğrudan kölelik statüsündeki kişiyi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kölelik durumunu, köle mülkiyetini ve köleleştirme eylemini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da insanın özgürlükten yoksun bırakılıp sahip olunması alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın göndergesi köle durumundaki insandır; komşu dal ise bu insanı da içeren daha geniş bir statü, mülkiyet ve köleleştirme alanı kurar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kişi özgür değildir ve bir başkasının mülkiyetinde sayılır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişi kölelik bağından çıkarılarak özgürlüğüne kavuşur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kişinin hukuki ve toplumsal özgürlük durumunu karşıt yönlerden ele alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal özgürlükten yoksun statüyü adlandırırken komşu dal o statünün sona erdirilmesini ve kişinin özgür kılınmasını anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; kişi ile kölelik alanını ayıran ve kölelik ile özgürleşme karşıtlığını gösteren iki ilişki sınırı en iyi açıklayan adaylardır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العبد المملوك وخلاف الحر ومن يصح بيعه وابتياعه وجموع العبيد والأعبد والعبدى والمعبدة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس عبادة الله ولا الطاعة الخاضعة ولا تعبيد الطريق أو البعير
branches.source_phrase_ar: العبد وهو المملوك (maqayis)؛ العبد المملوك وجمعه عبيد (ayn)؛ العبد ضد الحر (jamhara)؛ العبد خلاف الحر والجمع عبيد (sihah)؛ العبيد مماليك (tahdhib)؛ عبد بحكم الشرع الإنسان الذي يصح بيعه وابتياعه (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, özgür ya da köle her insanın yaratılmışlık ve aitlik bakımından Tanrı'nın kulu sayılmasını, ayrıca ona bağlı topluluğu bildirir. Bu kimlik, hukuki kölelikten ve tapınma eyleminden ayrı tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, insanın Tanrı'ya nispet edilen konumunu anlatır; kişinin hukuki statüsünü veya yaptığı tapınmayı tek başına bildirmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın insan adlandırması ile Tanrı'ya aitliği bildiren ad öbekleri birlikte bulunur; tanım bu kullanımları birbirine karıştırmadan kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Özgür ya da köle ayrımı olmaksızın insanın, yaratılmış ve ona ait olması bakımından Tanrı'nın kulu sayılmasıdır; çoğul kullanım ona bağlı topluluğu da gösterebilir.

facets.statement: Her insan yaratılmışlık ve aitlik bakımından Tanrı'nın kulu sayılabilir.
Çoğul adlandırma, Tanrı'ya bağlı topluluğu veya onun tarafında bulunanları gösterebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bu nispetin özgür ve köle bütün insanları kapsayabildiğini, yaratılmış olmaya dayandığını ve çoğul kullanımda Tanrı'ya bağlı topluluğu gösterebildiğini bildirir.

concept_gloss.text: Tanrı'ya ait sayılan insan veya topluluk
concept_gloss.applicability: Yaratılmışlık, aitlik ve topluluk bağlılığını hukuki kölelikle karıştırmadan birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: İnsanın Tanrı'ya ait sayılmasını ve çoğulda ona bağlı topluluğu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tek bir insanın yaratılmışlık ve aitlik yönünden Tanrı'ya nispet edildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tek kişinin Tanrı'ya ait sayılma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Çoğul kullanımın bağlı topluluk veya taraf anlamını göstermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Çoğul adlandırmanın bir topluluğu veya Tanrı'nın tarafında bulunanları gösterdiği yerde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Topluluk bağlılığını ve Tanrı'ya nispeti korur.
error_profile.loses: Tek tek bütün insanların yaratılmışlık temelindeki kulluğunu göstermez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: Tanrı'nın kulları veya ona bağlı topluluk

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnızca özgür olmayan ve insanlar arasında mülkiyet konusu sayılan kişiyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: Tanrı'ya kulluk nispeti ve hukuki kölelik

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bütün insanlara uzanabilen dinsel ve yaratılışsal bir nispet kurar; komşu dal ise insanlar arasındaki somut kölelik statüsünü adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kişinin yaratılmışlık veya bağlılık temelindeki konumunu bildirir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه إطلاق العبد على الإنسان حرا أو رقيقا منسوبا إلى الله وعلى الخلق عبيدا لله بالإيجاد وعلى جماعة عباد الله أو حزبه

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, çekirdeği boyun eğmeyle birlikte itaat ve tapınma olarak kurar; Tanrı'ya yönelen kullanım merkezde olsa da bir insana veya sahte tanrısal güce boyun eğme kullanımları da belirtilir. Bu nedenle tapınma, uysal itaat ve en ileri boyun eğme birlikte korunmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal hukuki köleliği değil, bir öznenin boyun eğerek itaat veya tapınma göstermesini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın eylem ve adlar ile belirli nesnelere yönelen söz öbekleri birlikte bulunur; özel nesneli kullanımlar bütün dalın tek sınırı yapılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa en ileri ölçüde boyun eğerek itaat etmek ve tapınma yönelişi göstermektir; dinsel kullanım Tanrı'ya, bazı özel söz öbekleri ise sahte tanrısal güçlere yönelir.

facets.statement: Eylem, sıradan itaati aşan bir boyun eğme ve alçalma tutumu içerir.
Merkezî dinsel kullanım, Tanrı'ya yönelen tapınma ve kendini bu yönelişe vermedir.
Boyun eğme, özel kullanımlarda bir insana veya sahte tanrısal güce yöneltilebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar tapınmayı boyun eğmeyle birlikte itaat ve en ileri alçalma olarak açıklar; dinsel yöneliş merkezdeyken insanlara veya sahte güçlere yönelen bağımlı kullanımlar da vardır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın hem davranışsal boyun eğme çekirdeğini hem de dinsel tapınma yönünü birlikte verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kişiyi köle edinme, köle durumuna getirme veya özgür olsa bile köle gibi çalışacak ölçüde boyunduruk altına alma eylemlerini ortak bir ettirgen çekirdekte birleştirir. Dal bu eylemi, kişinin mevcut kölelik statüsünden ayrı olarak tanımlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam insanı köleleştiren veya köle gibi boyunduruk altına alan eylemdir; tapınma ya da nesneleri kullanıma hazırlama değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın eylem anlamını taşır; tanım belirli bir söz öbeğine özgü kapsam eklemez.

facets.statement: Eyleyen, başka bir insanı köle edinir veya köle durumuna getirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir genel eylemden çok üç yapıya bağlı kullanımı yan yana verir: çok geçilerek düzleşmiş yol, katranlanmış ve uysallaştırılmış deve, katran veya yağla kaplanmış gemi. Dal korunabilir, ancak bu kullanımlar tek bir yalın anlammış gibi birleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tanım yalnızca verilen yol, deve ve gemi yapılarıyla sınırlıdır; insanı köleleştirme anlamına genellenemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal söz öbeğine bağlı yol ve deve anlamlarıyla bir gemi adlandırmasını birlikte taşır; her kullanım kendi nesnesi ve işlemiyle ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Verilen yapılarda yolun çok geçilerek düzleşip kolay kullanılır olması, devenin derisinin katranla kaplanıp uysallaştırılması veya geminin katran, yağ ya da benzeri bir maddeyle kaplanması anlatılır.

facets.statement: Yol kullanımı, sık geçişle basılıp düzleşmiş ve geçişe elverişli hâle gelmiş yolu niteler.
Deve kullanımı, derisi baştan başa katranlanmış ve bununla birlikte uysallaştırılmış hayvanı niteler.
Gemi kullanımı, dışı katran, yağ veya benzeri koruyucu maddeyle kaplanmış tekneyi niteler.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak ifadesi, yol için basılıp düzleşmeyi; deve için katranlanma ve uysallaşmayı; gemi içinse katran ya da yağla kaplanmayı ayrı gerçekleşmeler olarak verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi incinmiş gurur, öfke ve kendini koruma duygusunu merkezde verir; ayrıca keder ve yoğun iç duygulanımı aktarır. Geçici çerçevedeki kaçırılmış şey için pişmanlık ayrıntısı kaynak cümlesinde açık değildir, bu yüzden tanım bu ek koşula bağlanmadan kurulmuştur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal incinmiş gururdan yükselen öfke ile kederli iç duygulanımı kapsar; güç ve sağlamlık anlamından ayrıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın duygu adı ile gururu incindiği için susmayı anlatan söz öbeği birlikte bulunur; susma yalnız özel kullanımın sonucudur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki ayrı söz öbeğine bağlı anlam verir: bir işi yapmakta gecikmemek ve koşarken bir ölçü hızlanmak. Bunlar tek bir yalın eylem anlamına indirgenemez, fakat dal iki yapı açıkça ayrılarak korunabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız verilen iki söz öbeğinde gecikmeme veya biraz hızlanma bildirir; genel bir hız kökü gibi yorumlanmaz.

facets.statement: İlk yapı, belirtilen işi yapmak için beklememeyi ve kısa sürede harekete geçmeyi bildirir.
İkinci yapı, koşunun hızını bir miktar artırmayı bildirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali yalniz korkunun kalkmasi olarak degil, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme, guvenilirlik, emanet edilen sey, guvenli yer ve dayanilir nitelik alanlariyla birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi, guvenlik ve guvenilirlik ekseninde hem yalın hem de yapimli ve baglamli kullanislari ayirt ederek korunabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal inanma ya da dua cevabi degil; korkudan emin olma, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin guven ve korkusuzluk anlamlari ile belirli yapimli ya da soz obegi kullanislari birlikte vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir dar kaliba indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak bu dali korkunun ziddi olan guven, kalbin yatismasi ve guven verme alaninda toplar. Ayni iddia guvenilir kisi, emanet, guvenli yer ve dayanilir binek gibi turemis ya da baglamli kullanislari da cekirdege baglar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Korkunun kalkmasi, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanlarini birlikte tasiyan en kisa genel karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Hem guven halini hem de guvenilirlik ve emanet iliskisini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali acikca tasdik, haber ya da vaadi dogru sayma ve bazi dini kullanislarda hakka boyun egme olarak verir. Provisional cerceve guvene dokunan yanini not eder, fakat dal kimligi korkusuzluk degil tasdik ve kabul iliskisidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal guvenlik hali degil; bir soz, haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru kabul etme alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hem genel tasdik adlari hem de belirli soz obekleri ve dini kullanislar vardir; tanim bunlari yalin guven anlamina genisletmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip ona icten kabul ile yonelmektir. Dini kullanista bu kabul, kalp, dil ve davranisla baglanan bir boyun egme ya da seriate girme anlami kazanabilir.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
Hakka yonelik ic kabul, yalniz bilmekten ziyade boyun egme ve kabullenme bicimi alir.
Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
Ilahi sifat kullaniminda vaat edilen odulu dogrulama veya guvenceyle bildirme boyutu one cikar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalin ortak cekirdegini tasdik olarak verir ve bir sozun dogru sayilmasini temsil eden ornegi buna baglar. Ayni iddia, daha ozel dini kullanimlarda hakka icten boyun egme, yola girme ve vaatle ilgili dogrulama boyutlarinin eklendigini de gosterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Haber, vaat, hakikat ve dini baglanma kullanimlarini tasdik cekirdegi etrafinda birlestirir.

error_profile.preserves: Dogru sayma, ic kabul ve daha ozel dini baglanma imkanini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali dua icinde soylenen bir kabul istegi sozu ve bu sozu soyleme eylemi olarak verir. Cerceve, guven ve tasdik dallarindan ayrildigi ve sadece dua cevabi formuluyle ilgili oldugu icin uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal guvenlik ya da tasdik degil; duada kabul talebini bildiren sabit sozdur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal belirli bir dua sozu ve onu soyleme eylemiyle sinirlidir; buradan genel guven ya da tasdik anlami cikarilmaz.

concept_map.definition: Dua sonunda kabul edilme istegini bildiren ve 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' ya da 'bunu yap' anlaminda aciklanan sabit sozdur. Dal ayrica bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve kaynaklarda aktarılan ad yorumunu da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek, duada kabul istegini bildiren sabit cevap sozudur.
Kaynaklar sozun anlamini 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' veya 'bunu yap' seklinde aciklar.
Bu sozu soyleme eylemi de ayni dal icinde adlandirilir.
Bazi aktarimlarda bu sozun ilahi bir ad oldugu yorumu da dalin yan rivayeti olarak bulunur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak dali dua icinde soylenen ve kabul istegi tasiyan sabit bir soz olarak anlatir. Ayni iddia, bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve sozun anlamina dair 'kabul et' ya da 'oyle olsun' aciklamalarini da icerir; ad yorumu ise bu ortak malzemenin yan aktarimidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, sözcüğün temel olarak kadınlar dışındaki erkekler topluluğunu anlattığını, kadınların ancak ikincil biçimde kapsama girebildiğini ve insan dışı varlıklara aktarılabildiğini gösterir. Bu nedenle genel ve cinsiyetçe sınırsız bir topluluk adı olarak sunulmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel kapsam erkekler topluluğudur; kadınların katılımı ve insan dışına aktarım ikincil kullanımlardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, temel topluluk anlamını bağlı anlatımlardaki yandaş ve soy çevresi anlamından ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Temelde erkeklerden oluşan insan topluluğudur; bir erkeğin yandaş ve yakın soy çevresini de anlatabilir. Kadınların topluluğa bağlı olarak kapsanması ve sözün insan dışı varlıklara aktarılması ikincildir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bedeni dik konuma getirme ve dik durma çekirdeğini açıkça destekler. Tek seferlik ayağa kalkma, ibadet sırasındaki duruş, bitkinin kökü üzerinde dik kalması ve hayvanın durması bu fiziksel çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal fiziksel dikilme ve dik duruşla sınırlıdır; niyet, gözetim ve yerleşme anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Fiziksel dik duruş çekirdeği korunur; belirli duruş ve kök üzerinde kalma anlatımları ona bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın ya da başka bir varlığın dik konuma gelmesi veya dik durumda bulunmasıdır. Tek seferlik ayağa kalkma, ibadetteki ayakta duruş, bitkinin kökü üzerinde kalması ve hayvanın durması bu fiziksel duruşun özel görünümleridir.

facets.statement: Canlı ya da cansız bir varlık dik konuma gelir veya dik durumda bulunur.
Tek ayağa kalkış, ibadet duruşu, kökü üzerinde dik kalan bitki ve duran hayvan fiziksel çekirdeğin bağlama özgü görünümleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dikilme ve dik durma çekirdeğinde birleşir; tek bir ayağa kalkışın yanı sıra ibadet, bitki ve hayvan bağlamlarını da bu çekirdeğe bağlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Fiziksel olarak dik konuma gelme ile o konumda bulunma aşamalarını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Hem dikilme hareketini hem de ortaya çıkan dik duruşu korur.

error_profile.preserves: Dik duruşu ve bu duruşun sürmesini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, belirli bir işe yönelip onu üstlenme anlamındaki kararlı niyet ve girişimi destekler. Anlam yalnız zihinsel isteme değil, işe doğru yönelme ve onu üzerine alma aşamasına da bağlıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin baskın çekirdeği bir işi, topluluğu ya da düzeni sürekli gözetmek, korumak ve yönetmektir. Aynı ifadede bir işi üstlenmeye değinen unsur önceki niyet dalıyla örtüştüğünden, burada ancak sürekli sorumluluk ve koruma doğurduğu ölçüde kullanılmalıdır.
